children.name:
Continue a delivered workstream into production observation, alerts, and
      attributable remediation so operational reality becomes part of product
      memory rather than disappearing into a separate monitoring silo.
terms:
"
      Continue a delivered workstream into production observation, alerts, and
      attributable remediation so operational reality becomes part of product
      memory rather than disappearing into a separate monitoring silo.
      "
"Relate observations and alerts to exact deployments and their originating workstreams whenever that lineage is known."
"Implementation is not the result; reliable behavior in production is the result."
"Do not end traceability at merge, release, deployment success, or a manually closed ticket."
"Let policy-authorized automation triage an alert and prepare or link a bug workstream without granting itself unrestricted remediation rights."
"Fast response and human accountability must coexist, especially for production mutations."
"Do not let severity, agent confidence, or an external webhook bypass access, approval, tool, or rollback policy."

children.name: A production observation names one succeeded deployment, a bounded observation window, health assessment, and immutable monitoring report.
terms: "A production observation names one succeeded deployment, a bounded observation window, health assessment, and immutable monitoring report."

children.name: Unknown production health cannot satisfy an evidence gate that requires healthy observation.
terms: "Unknown production health cannot satisfy an evidence gate that requires healthy observation."

children.name: An alert is idempotent by its source and external reference, retains the raw alert artifact, and may link to at most one primary remediation workstream.
terms: "An alert is idempotent by its source and external reference, retains the raw alert artifact, and may link to at most one primary remediation workstream."

children.name: An alert linked to a deployment inherits its project and causal change lineage; absence of a deployment link remains explicit rather than guessed.
terms: "An alert linked to a deployment inherits its project and causal change lineage; absence of a deployment link remains explicit rather than guessed."

children.name: Critical or high alerts may request immediate triage, but production mutation still requires current access, tool, approval, blast-radius, and rollback policy.
terms: "Critical or high alerts may request immediate triage, but production mutation still requires current access, tool, approval, blast-radius, and rollback policy."

children.name: PrepareBugWorkstream may create a draft Bug workstream and ticket evidence; it cannot mark the ticket reviewed, ready, implemented, deployed, observed, or done.
terms: "PrepareBugWorkstream may create a draft Bug workstream and ticket evidence; it cannot mark the ticket reviewed, ready, implemented, deployed, observed, or done."

children.name: StartApprovedRemediation is permitted only by explicit project policy for the alert class and still creates an inspectable coding run and artifact lineage.
terms: "StartApprovedRemediation is permitted only by explicit project policy for the alert class and still creates an inspectable coding run and artifact lineage."

children.name: Resolving an alert requires resolution evidence and does not automatically prove the originating defect fixed or the workstream done.
terms: "Resolving an alert requires resolution evidence and does not automatically prove the originating defect fixed or the workstream done."

children.name: Production timeline access follows workstream and project access and never exposes protected logs, code, environments, or alerts by possession of an identifier.
terms: "Production timeline access follows workstream and project access and never exposes protected logs, code, environments, or alerts by possession of an identifier."
